context: Hiroshi-boss and Ren discuss hiring and ethics.
purpose: WIDENED SCENARIO: business HR; vocabulary (面接/説得/会う/倫理/連携) in natural home.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 来週、面接を行う予定だ。
lines.style: composed boss voice, soft warm authoritative clarity throughout

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 何名の候補者と、会うんですか?
lines.en: How many candidates will we meet?
lines.style: engaged young manager voice, soft warm professional focus throughout

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 五名と会う。面接は丁寧にな。
lines.en: We'll meet five. Interview them carefully.
lines.style: measured boss voice, soft warm authoritative clarity throughout

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 倫理観も、見るべきですか?
lines.en: Should we assess their ethics too?
lines.style: thoughtful young manager voice, soft warm professional focus throughout

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: ああ、倫理は何より大切だ。
lines.style: firm boss voice, soft warm authoritative clarity throughout

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 優秀な人は、説得が要りますね。
lines.style: measured young manager voice, soft warm professional focus throughout

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 部署との連携も、説得材料になる。
lines.en: Cooperation across departments is a selling point.
lines.style: composed boss voice, soft warm clarity throughout

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 面接で、連携の良さを伝えます。
lines.en: I'll convey our good cooperation in the interview.
lines.style: resolved young manager voice, soft warm closing throughout
